This product works just as expected. It makes a carafe of coffee using any coffee that I want to use. I have found some difficulty with the paper filters. They are not easy to install, and when brewing, the coffee has a tendency to overflow. Other than that, this product works great and I'll continue to use it. I have also found that when using very fine ground coffee, some of the coffee residue comes through into the carafe. I recommend using a coffee that is ground slightly larger than "fine".

I like coffee from my Keurig 550, but when it comes to a lot of people being over, making 5 k-cups is so expensive. It's easier just to get your own ground coffee and make a huge carafe. I was so excited to get the opportunity to put this reusable carafe to the test! I had an issue with my first carafe coming in broken, but the company was prompt and send me a new one right away! It even comes with filters and a little coffee scoop! It worked great to make a big pot of coffee instead of a ton of individual cups. You can use already ground coffee or you can grind your own, it works fine either way :) It saves me so much money doing it now than buying the carafe packs! I would definitely recommend!

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review!

Ok, I have had this little gem for a few weeks now. It works perfect with my 2.0 machine. It came with filters, which are needed because a lot of sediment gets through mesh filter of this reusable K-cup. My only complaint is the filter size, it appears Nature's Kitchen only sells the regular K-cup size and not tall ones to fit this Carafe size reusable K-Cup pod. The shorter filter that I believe is made for the individual size K-cup pod works OK for the Carafe size. It is just very difficult to dig out after use and I think some of the coffee grounds still get through. I am giving this gem 4 stars and would love to give it 5 stars if Nature's Kitchen would make taller filters for it. There is a company on Amazon that sells taller filters for their carafe K-cup pod, but they charge a lot for just 60 filters. Nature's Kitchen seems to have more reasonable priced items, which is why I implore them to make talker filters so I can buy from them.

I love this carafe cup, they finally came out with a re-usable cup for the Keurig 2.0.  This cup will open up all the options in the coffee maker so you can make virtually any size cup you want, and the option for regular or bold.  I believe it was Keurig’s design to force you to keep buying their expensive cups and now with this cup, you can use your own brand of coffee and save a bundle. The cup is made of durable plastic and the hinge is separate and easily comes apart to clean. I suggest you get 2 or more depending on how many people drink coffee or tea in your family.  Some sellers give you a small scoop and paper filters.  You do not need the paper filters, in fact they will absorb the natural oils from the ground coffee and you will lose some of the flavor in the process.
Works well, no issues. Love the fact it has an actual hinge and not just a flimsy thin plastic fold like most of the normal cheap sized ones.
